title: Review process: rejection reasons are one org-wide list instead of per process

panels.caption: Setup → Review Process list → "Configure Rejection Reasons" (one list for all processes)
Setup → Review Processes → open process "test" → Configure Reasons For Record Rejection

rows.zoho: Inside each review process editor (ACTIONS → Configure Reasons For Record Rejection), saved with that process
rows.tavi: One button on the Review Process list page; the review process object has no reasons setting (GET /workflow/review-processes)

rows.zoho: Reasons belong to the process being edited ("Click Save, to save the entire review process")
rows.tavi: One list (GET /workflow/review-rejection-reasons) shared by all 5 review processes; editing it changes every process
10 active reasons for the whole org ("3 of 10 active")

rows.b: Default reasons and reason required on reject
rows.zoho: Invalid entry, Data insufficient, Data does not match; a reason must be picked

notes: Zoho captured read-only from the existing process "test" (dialog opened, Cancel, nothing saved). Zoho help: https://help.zoho.com/portal/en/kb/crm/process-management/review-process/articles/review-process (steps 9–10) and FAQ Q17/Q31.
Not proven by data: Zoho's help does not say "per process" in words; the setting lives in, and is saved with, each process.
